theme: Reading tomorrow's data with today's code
title: Wire-Tag Reservation Across Schema Versions
strategies: declaration-order tag assignment, ignoring frequency entirely (trivial)
current-frequency-greedy: sort version-1 fields by their own frequency, bolt on later fields FCFS (greedy)
lifetime-weighted reservation: sort every field (including unborn ones) by frequency times versions-active before committing any tag (strong)
joint tag+encoding co-design under the full multi-version workload (open ceiling, uncovered)
